tip: Turns 1-2 are skipped, so don't worry about early tempo. On turn 3 level up (it's cheap) and play both Discovers; pick minions that fit a tribe or carry you to midgame.
Your left-most minion gets Windfury, Divine Shield and Taunt every combat. Park your biggest attacker there, ideally one with Cleave, Venomous or an on-attack effect.
The Hero Power unlocks at Tier 4, so level fast early. From then on Discover a Dragon every turn and build a Dragon board.
Turn 1 is skipped, but each Discovered minion arrives when you reach its Tier. Pick a Tier 6 carry first and plan your tribe and leveling around it.
Play a full board early so more minions attack each combat and the 14-attack counter runs out fast. After that, plan each turn around one free minion.
Use it before fights against strong boards: you keep a copy of the first minion you kill. A left-most Venomous or high-Attack minion helps grab the key pieces.
Every card you buy counts toward 14, spells included, so spend all your gold each turn. Pick the Protoss minion that fits your planned build at game start.
You buy an extra Greater Trinket on turn 8, so save gold for it. Take scaling or economy trinkets, since you get a second one on turn 9.
Every Pirate refunds 1 Gold, so Pirates cost 2. Roll for them, buy-sell cheap Pirates for tempo, and build Pirates whenever they're in the lobby.
The Golden minion comes from your current Tier, so use spare gold on early digs and save the last one for right after you level up.
Free each turn: turn weak or outdated minions into a Discover from one Tier lower. Great for finding the third copy of a pair or a key tribe piece.
Play cheap Elementals early: every 3 make leveling 3 cheaper, so you can race up Tiers. Without Elementals in the lobby the power does almost nothing.
Every Golden minion you play gives both you and Gall a Triple Reward. Pass copies to each other to finish triples quickly.
Every Golden minion you play gives both you and Cho a Triple Reward. Pass copies to each other to finish triples quickly.
Throw in cheap minions of the tribe you want: three of one type guarantees a Discover from that tribe.
Every minion you play gets a +1/+1 hat, and selling passes its hats on. Buy-sell cheap minions every turn to pile hats onto the minions you keep.
Two clicks per turn (1 Gold each) give 4 Blood Gems. Dump leftover gold into them every turn, and pick up Quilboar or trinkets that make Blood Gems stronger.
Your minions keep the +2 Attack after every combat, so hold on to your core minions. Enemies get +2 too, so Divine Shield and high Health trade well.
Buy Battlecry minions early to get Brann quickly, then build around strong Battlecries since Brann doubles them.
From turn 7 your highest-Attack minion is copied when space opens. Stack Attack on one strong minion, and play 6 minions or fewer so the copy comes at once.
Discard spare spells or extra cards for Aberrations, and look for Aberrations that reward discarding, which turn every use into a buff.
Buy lots of cheap cards early to improve the buff, and keep stacking it on one minion you'll keep, ideally one with Divine Shield or Taunt.
The cost rises by 1 after each use, so don't spam it. Use it right after leveling to grab a minion from your new Tier.
Each Refresh adds Bonus Keywords to Tavern minions, so roll often and buy the ones with Divine Shield, Windfury, Reborn or Venomous on strong bodies.
Cast your best Tavern spell first, then copy it. The cost drops 1 each turn, so waiting a turn or two to copy a big buff or gold spell is often worth it.
Pick a cheap placeholder to transform each combat, and ask your teammate to keep a strong high-Tier minion, since that's what you copy.
Extra max Gold pays off over time, so use it early (turns 2-5) even at a small tempo cost. Late in the game, spend the 3 Gold on your board instead.
Every upgrade refunds 2 Gold, so level often and spend the refund on rolls or minions. A fast leveling curve is the plan.
Sell often: every 5 minions sold gives a random Murloc. Buy-sell cheap minions for tempo and go Murlocs if they're strong in the lobby.
Use it on weak Tavern minions to see higher-Tier options before you level. On low Tiers it's a cheap way to find strong cards and tribe pieces.
You have no Hero Power until turn 4, so play for tempo early. Then pick two Hero Powers that work together, such as one for economy and one for scaling.
Shields given in the shop stay between combats, so cover a new key minion each turn. Strong with minions that reward losing Divine Shield.
Every minion summoned in combat gains +1/+2 and Taunt. Build around Deathrattle, Reborn and token summoners; Undead do well.
Higher-Tier cards fill the 20-Tier counter faster, so level and buy high-Tier minions. Save each Triple Reward until after you level for a better Discover.
The cost drops by 1 each turn. Use it once it's cheap, right after leveling or a roll, when the Tavern is full of cards you want.
Both end minions attack first with +2/+1. Put Cleave, Venomous or high-Attack minions there; keep Taunts and late-game Deathrattles in the middle.
Use it instead of a normal roll: each shop shows two minions from a Tier higher. Stay on a lower Tier longer and still find strong cards.
Put both uses on the same minion you'll keep; leveling makes each use bigger. It alternates between Attack and Health, so it suits a big Taunt carry.
Deathrattle, Reborn and token boards reach 9 deaths fast, giving you a free Mech every few fights. Best when Mechs are in the lobby.
A free swap each turn: trade your weakest minion for a random Tavern minion, best right after leveling when the shop has higher-Tier cards. Golden minions can't be swapped.
Your Battlecruiser is the carry: roll often to find Battlecruiser Upgrades and keep buying them. Protect it with Taunts or Divine Shield.
Every third minion you buy gives a Tavern Coin. Buy-sell cheap minions to finish the counter each turn and turn the Coins into rolls or levels.
Keep the Larva all game: it morphs into a Zerg each turn and keeps its stats and buffs. Unlock Spawning Pool once its cost has dropped.
For 2 Gold you pick one of two minions and discard the other. Strongest with Aberrations, whose discard effects trigger from the discarded card.
Buy 3 minions each turn for a free copy of one, using buy-sell loops if needed. Buying pairs makes the copy more likely to finish a triple.
Wide boards and Windfury reach 15 attacks faster. Save each Triple Reward until after you level up for a higher-Tier Discover.
Bet on the player with the clearly stronger board; 1 Gold for 3 Coins is great value. Skip it when the matchup looks like a coin flip.
Lock key cards for 1 Gold, such as a high-Tier minion or a triple piece. They stay locked for 2 turns, so don't use it on cards you need right now.
Two free rerolls a turn: replace weak minions on your board, or single Tavern minions, with random ones of the same Tier. Use it after leveling for better odds.
Keep gold on turn 5 for the extra Lesser Trinket. Economy or scaling trinkets bought this early pay off the most.
Minions cost 2, but Refreshes also cost 2 and leveling 1 more. Buy from every shop, roll sparingly, and level when you can afford it.
The Hero Power unlocks at Tier 4, so level quickly, then Discover a Magnetic Mech every turn and stack them on one strong Mech.
Two copies make a Golden, so buy duplicates aggressively, especially strong low-Tier minions. Goldens give Tavern Coins instead of Discovers.
Each elimination gives you a buffed minion from that warband. Play to survive and stabilize rather than all-in tempo; you get stronger as the lobby shrinks.
Sell through the Hero Power instead of normal selling to move stats onto one keeper. Buffed minions you no longer need make great food.
Keep the Fish all game and build Deathrattles. Put it on the right or behind Taunts so it dies late and copies more Deathrattles first.
Every 4 friendly deaths summon a Whelp that attacks at once, and the Whelp grows each time. Wide, token-heavy and Deathrattle boards trigger it more.
Buy lots of minions (buy-sell loops count) to grow the Tavern buff; every minion you buy later comes with the extra stats.
Sell minions often: each sale permanently grows the Tentacle. It only appears when you have space, so have early deaths or leave a slot open.
Each Pirate you buy makes the next use 1 Gold cheaper, often free. Alternate buying Pirates and using the power to build a Pirate board fast.
One minion of each type is buffed every combat, so run several different types. Spending gold improves it, so roll and buy freely.
Buy 12 cards (spells count) quickly to get Sulfuras, then keep your two best minions on the ends to stack +8/+8 on them every turn.
Every Tavern spell gives extra stats, and the bonus grows every 3 turns. Spend gold on buff spells and spell generators instead of rolling for minions.
Save the Golden for a high-Tier or scaling minion whose Golden version doubles its effect. Use it early only to survive a bad stretch.
Before the turn it triggers, put your most valuable card (a key minion or strong spell) left-most in hand so you copy it.
From turn 3 you repeat a Battlecry every turn. Keep a strong Battlecry minion, ideally one that gives stats or makes cards, on board and trigger it each turn.
Buy minions that carry Darkmoon Tickets; every 3 Tickets give a free Discover of your Tier. Pick the ticket minion when choices are close.
Minions cost 2, so you can buy an extra card most turns. The Tavern freezes itself, so roll only when you need new options.
Gold grows by 1 each turn you wait. Save it for a big spike turn, like leveling to Tier 5 or 6 and rolling, or to survive when low.
Keep a strong minion in hand: the Shredder summons it in combat with Divine Shield, giving you an extra fighter. Great with hand-buff effects.
Buy Tavern spells steadily so every third one is free, and make the free one your most expensive spell.
Your lowest-Attack minion spreads its stats when it dies. Stack Health on a low-Attack minion and put it on the left so it dies early.
Pick a Deathrattle minion: it dies at Start of Combat, triggering its Deathrattle, then comes back as an exact copy. Leave room for it to return.
Copy boards of opponents who play your tribe to find key minions and triples cheaply; skip it after facing a weak or off-tribe board.
The Amalgam counts as every tribe, so every tribal buff hits it. Keep it all game as a Venomous blocker and stack buffs on it.
From Tier 2, turn Undead you'd sell into new random Undead. Destroying Deathrattle Undead (like Plaguerunner) also triggers them in the shop.
Give Reborn to your best Deathrattle minion or biggest Taunt each turn, so Deathrattles trigger twice and key minions come back.
Spend all your gold every turn (rolls count) to reach 60 quickly, and pick a Tier 7 minion that fits your planned build at game start.
The Tier 5 Dark Gift minion arrives on turn 7, so pick one that defines a build and steer your tribe toward it from the start.
From turn 7 your highest-Health minion is copied when space opens. Stack Health on one Taunt or Deathrattle minion and play 6 minions or fewer.
Each Refresh duplicates its best minion and freezes both. Roll for high-Tier pairs to build triples, and plan buys across turns since copies stay frozen.
Grab minions whose value is their effect, not their stats, for 2 Gold. Great for picking up key effects or triple pieces.
Every Refresh shows an extra Dragon, so Dragons are the natural build. Roll often for Dragon triples and keep leveling to see better Dragons.
Buy pairs of strong minions and wish for the third. Spend wishes on high-Tier pairs for the best Golden and a better Triple Reward.
Save it for a heavily buffed or high-impact minion; copying a scaled carry late is worth far more than an early copy.
Buy every Eternal Knight: each Knight death buffs the rest, and Taunt + Reborn makes them die twice. Only take it if you're on Undead.
Every Undead death grows your Eternal Knights for the rest of the game. Run a wide Undead board with Reborn and keep the Knights where they survive.
Only take it with a Deathrattle board: Titus makes them trigger twice, and the doubled Health keeps him alive longer. Keep him behind your Taunts.
Each turn, destroy a cheap Undead with Butchering for +8 Attack on all your Undead this game. Needs an Undead build and spare Undead to destroy.
Grows your Blood Gems every few friendly deaths, so it needs a Blood Gem-heavy Quilboar build and a wide board.
Every Quilboar that dies gives 2 Blood Gems, so it scales with Quilboar count. Skip it without a Quilboar board.
Each turn, upgrade a minion to one a Tier higher. Use it on cheap or outdated minions and pick upgrades that fit your tribe; buffs on the old minion are lost.
Commit to Battlecries: Brann doubles them, and since he's a Murloc and a Dragon, tribal buffs for either can grow him.
Gold and a Tier 6 Discover arrive every two turns whatever your Tier, so you can stay lower, roll for triples and still get late-game power.
A free minion of the shown tribe every turn. Take it only if that tribe is, or can become, your main build; the free copies also help make triples.
Every Refresh shows 2 extra minions of the shown tribe. Take it only if you want that tribe, then roll hard for triples.
Your next minion of the shown tribe becomes Golden. Use the 5 free Refreshes to find a strong high-Tier one before buying any of that tribe.
Each Tavern spell buffs your Elementals and the shop's. Needs an Elemental board plus a steady flow of cheap spells.
Only your first spell each turn is doubled, so cast your strongest spell first, like a big buff, gold or Discover spell.
Two copies make a Golden Pirate. Buy Pirate pairs aggressively for frequent Goldens and Triple Rewards.
Play Blood Gems on your Quilboar so they leave big Golems when they die. Best on a full Quilboar board with Blood Gem buffs.
Only Beasts summoned in combat get doubled Attack, so you need Deathrattle, Reborn or token-making Beasts.
Grows when your hero takes damage outside combat, so pair it with Demons, Health-cost cards or other self-damage effects.
Play Elementals every turn, then roll and freeze to buy the buffed shop Elementals. It snowballs only in an Elemental build.
The first Quilboar attack each combat plays Blood Gems on all your Quilboar, so run several Quilboar.
Each Tavern spell permanently adds Attack to your Undead, including ones you buy later. Cast many cheap spells with an Undead board.
Only the first Deathrattle each combat triggers twice. Make sure your best Deathrattle dies first, e.g. left-most with low Health.
Every fourth card costs Health instead of Gold, so make it an expensive one (a high-Tier minion or big spell). Watch your Health late.
Each turn you can swap it for one of 2 new Lesser Trinkets for free. Keep cycling until one fits your board, then take it.
Leveling gets 3 cheaper every turn and it stacks, so level almost every turn. It suits a fast leveling plan, not staying low to roll.
Copies come from your own board, so keep it full of strong keepers. Duplicate copies often turn into triples.
Strong with active or repeatable Hero Powers that do something each use; check what yours does first, as some passives gain little.
Only good with Deathrattles. Keep the Fish on the right so it dies after your Deathrattle minions and copies their effects.
Pure economy: +1 max Gold every turn with no instant power. Take it when your board can survive a few turns, then out-roll everyone late.
Hold the Manipulator in hand until it can copy your best minion or finish a triple.
Every 4 Refreshes grow the Tavern buff, so roll a lot; every minion you buy gets bigger. Strong with heroes or cards that give free Refreshes.
Best with boards that summon in combat (Deathrattle, Reborn or token makers); each summon gets Divine Shield, up to 5 per combat.
Turns into a copy of your Greater Trinket, giving you two. Plan for a Greater Trinket that stacks well, like scaling or economy.
Gets you a Greater Trinket two turns early, so keep gold for it. Strong when you can win with a big trinket spike before turn 9.
Every card you play (spells too) gives a Dragon +4/+4. Cheap spells and buy-sell loops scale your Dragons quickly.
After each minion you play, the left-most minion in hand gets stats. Keep your next keeper left-most and play other cards first to stack it.
Triggers on every Gold spend, so spend in small chunks (rolls, single buys) instead of one big purchase to buff more Pirates.
Two Magnetic Mecha-Demons each turn: Magnetize them onto one strong Mech. Needs Mechs on board to stick.
Blood Gems from hand become huge, but you need a steady Blood Gem source. Play gems on one carry rather than spreading them.
Your two lowest-Attack minions get doubled. Make them high-Health Taunts or minions worth doubling, not 1-Attack tokens.
Gives Health equal to half Attack, so it rewards Attack-only scaling (Undead, Pirates, Attack buffs).
Removes Tier 1-2 cards from your shop. Avoid it if your build relies on low-Tier key minions or triples.
Each Monster grows with every Magnetize this game. Magnetize often, and stack the Monsters onto one big Mech.
Your Greater Trinket shop opens next turn instead of turn 9, so keep gold for it.
Buy high-stat minions to make big Satellites (twice per turn) and Magnetize them onto one Mech.
Plays Blood Gems on one minion of each type every turn, so run many different types (multi-type minions help).
Only for Deathrattle boards. Summon Deathrattles need open slots at Start of Combat, so Deathrattles that give stats work best.
Needs 15 Gold at once, which is usually only possible late or with gold-generating cards. Weak if you can't bank gold.
Put your strongest Undead, ideally Deathrattle ones, on both ends so they come back.
You get a copy every turn, so pick a minion that wants duplicates: one that makes a strong triple or whose effect stacks.
Your Dragons keep stats and keywords gained in combat. Only take it with Dragons that grow during fights.
Your first two Refreshes each turn show only Tier 6 cards. Roll twice every turn to find late-game carries and Tier 6 triples.
Doubles end of turn effects, so only take it if you have or can find several end of turn minions or trinkets.
Turns every minion into a random Tier 4 minion, so buffs and Goldens are lost. Only take it when your board is weaker than that.
Your first Battlecry each turn triggers 3 times, so play your strongest Battlecry first each turn.
10 Gold arrives in two turns. Plan that turn as a big spike: level up and roll, or buy a key upgrade.
Blood Gems count as spells, so Quilboar or spell-heavy builds trigger it often and every minion gets Blood Gems.
You steal the highest-Tier card in the Tavern at end of turn, so finish your turn on a shop with a strong card (level or roll last).
Hackerfin's buff grows with each different Bonus Keyword on your board. Collect Divine Shield, Taunt, Reborn, Venomous and Windfury.
Morgl's kills give stats to a minion in your hand, so keep a card in hand during combat. Its Poisonous lets it trade up into anything.
Makes a random minion of Tier 4 or below Golden each turn. Keep low-Tier minions with strong Golden versions on board.
Sell Elementals every turn to feed the Behemoth their stats; buy-sell cheap Elementals to grow it fast.
Each Demon you play lets another Demon eat a Tavern minion. Roll first so they eat high-stat minions, and keep several Demons on board.
The Enforcer's eaten stats also go to its neighbors, so put your two best minions next to it.
Each turn, destroy an Undead you don't need to get a random Undead. Destroying Deathrattle Undead triggers them in the shop.
Each turn, destroy a weak Undead for two new ones. Destroying Deathrattle Undead triggers them in the shop.
Every Pirate you get, bought or generated, gives your left-most minion +20/+20. Keep your carry left-most.
Your 3 left-most minions die at once (triggering Deathrattles) and return when the rest are dead. Put Deathrattles or your strongest minions there.
Each minion that dies gives the survivors +3/+3 permanently. Wide boards and token or Reborn summoners get the most out of it.
Every Magnetize onto another minion also hits the Beatboxer. Only take it if you have a steady supply of Magnetic minions.
Needs Mechs on both ends of your board; each Accord-o-Tron adds stats and 1 Gold per turn, so it's both scaling and economy.
Keep your two best Battlecry minions on the far left and right so they trigger every turn.
Keep one huge-Attack minion in hand all game; your Murlocs copy its Attack every combat.
Each turn you get a shop of 1-Gold Battlecry minions. Buy several and sell what you don't need; great with Battlecry payoffs.
Only good with an active Hero Power you want to use twice a turn. Passive or once-per-game powers gain little.
Pays out only on reaching Tier 6, so take it when you plan to level fast; skip it if you'll stay low.
10 Gold now, but your Greater Trinket becomes a Lesser one. Take it when you need tempo to stabilize.
Ice Block saves you from dying once. Take it when your Health is low and you plan to spend gold on economy.
Every Refresh adds +9/+9 to a random shop minion, and it stacks each turn. Roll a lot and freeze big minions.
Every Beast you summon gets +7/+7, including in combat, so Beasts that summon tokens get the most from it.
Gives a free Refresh with copies of your minions. Use it when you hold pairs, to finish triples.
Use the extra copies on minions you already have one of, so each buy makes a triple or a strong duplicate.
Your first two Battlecry minions each turn are free, so roll for Battlecry minions and build around them.
Every Battlecry gives both end minions +5/+5. Keep carries on the ends and play lots of Battlecries (Brann doubles them).
Destroy the Plaguerunner outside combat (Butchering, Jailer effects) for +4 Undead Attack and a free copy to repeat.
Triggers a Deathrattle in the shop each turn. Use it on Deathrattles that give permanent stats or cards.
Doubles every spell you cast on a friendly minion. Strong with buff spells and Blood Gems.
Put Deathrattles that give permanent stats or cards in your two left-most slots; they trigger every turn.
Triggers all your Rallies at end of turn, so it only pays off with several Rally minions on board.
Doubles your Dragons' Battlecries. Take it when you have Dragon Battlecries that give stats.
Gold for each different minion type on your board. Run a mixed board (multi-type minions count) for strong economy.
Every Golden you play makes the end of turn buff bigger. Chase triples and Golden effects early.
Choose One cards get both effects. Only worth it with a steady supply of Choose One cards.
Copies a friendly minion with a Dark Gift, so only take it if you have strong Dark Gift minions.
At end of turn you get 3 copies of your last Tavern spell, so make your strongest spell the last one you cast each turn.
Discarding a Corrupted Coin gives +2 max Gold permanently. With a discard source (Aberrations, Kith'ix), discard them instead of playing them.
Becomes a random Greater Dragon Trinket after 11 friendly attacks. Only take it if you're on Dragons.
Becomes a random Greater Pirate Trinket after you spend 40 Gold. Only take it if you're on Pirates.
Becomes a random Greater Quilboar Trinket after 10 Blood Gems played from hand. Only take it if you're on Quilboar.
Becomes a random Greater Undead Trinket after you summon 25 minions. Only take it if you're on Undead.
You lose your Hero Power and get two copies of the chosen trinket. Only take it if your Hero Power is weak or used up.
Discarding Sludge Corrosion casts it twice and gives you another. Needs a discard source, like Aberrations or a discard Hero Power.
Sell Snarky Sharks to make Fishbait for your Beasts; each Fishbait death buffs all Beasts and improves the trinket.
Alternate buying a minion and a Tavern spell to get 1 Gold back on each purchase.
Each Tableware buffs more for every minion type you have. Run a mixed board to get the most from it.
Your Demons also take keywords and +5/+5 when they eat. Roll for high-stat or keyword-rich minions before eating.
Cast Tavern spells before ending your turn to grow the Satellite, then Magnetize it onto a Mech.
Cast buff spells on a high-stat Tavern minion; then one of your minions eats it and gains everything.
